decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's integrated airport operations platform, another year of customer use should deepen learning and make withdrawal unlikely.
Because this connectivity module builds directly on existing apron integration know-how, the firm can absorb field feedback efficiently and continue improving it within the wider system.

Billing software is less central to the operational core than the other products, but it still uses the firm's airport data and software capabilities enough to justify retention while its platform fit is further tested.
Equipment monitoring closely matches the firm's installed-base experience, maintenance capabilities, and data-driven service model, so management would be inclined to refine rather than abandon it.
Resource management sits near the core of airport efficiency improvement, and the firm's strong operational knowledge and R&D capacity support continued commercial application and learning.
